## 8f10b83435aa

**Finding A1 — reproduced teaching/distribution defect: the generated domain omits singleton panel occupancy, so a union shortcut is indistinguishable from the intended two-of-three threshold.**

The canonical task overlays three equal-width panels and emits color 8 at local coordinates occupied in at least two panels. The audited generator instead produced only local occupancy counts 0, 2, or 3 in a 300-grid sample: easy/medium/hard, seeds 1–100, `sample_index=seed`. The retained histogram is 5,638 zero positions, 1,482 count-two positions, 668 count-three positions, and **zero count-one positions**. Consequently, the rival “emit 8 wherever any panel is occupied” agreed with the intended rule on all 300/300 sampled generated inputs. Evidence: `checks/audit/8f10b83435aa/singleton-coverage.json`.

This is not merely hypothetical. Canonical train example 0 passes the target generator's validator (`self_check: []`) and contains singleton positions. The retained exact input is `checks/audit/8f10b83435aa/input.json`. The canonical Racket authority outputs 0 at local coordinates `(0,0)` and `(1,0)`, while the union rival outputs 8 there. The hash-bound Racket result is `checks/audit/8f10b83435aa/racket.json`; the rival and differing cells are in `checks/audit/8f10b83435aa/rival.json`. The audited generator hash was `23c4da5187cc4ae031c6347646a89d19d15056894e6cea5ddb79df2c927d9c14`.

**Suggested local repair, not applied:** permit lawful local positions occupied in exactly one panel and schedule at least one such example in every lesson. Declare and execute the union rival so lesson checks can verify that demonstrations refute it.

triage.reason: Accepted source-bound findings-only audits; exact reproductions retained. Generator contract/teaching defects are repair candidates, no-issue outcomes remain bounded; duplicates do not count as new defects.

## 8f10b83435aa

**No issue found in the checked surface.** Audited generator SHA-256 `a435a00bc4b849d31965afb03b669f2d60df069f84b43f79f1fd9c6225f80b08`. I checked 120 default grids (40 per difficulty band) plus six exact boundary cases. Every one of the 126 grids contained all eight possible three-panel occupancy signatures—empty, each singleton, each pair, and triple—so any pointwise Boolean rule on panel occupancy is completely identified within one generated example. The exact observer recovered every requested axis in all six boundary cases, and unknown, floating-point, and string controls rejected loudly. Evidence: `checks/audit/8f10b83435aa-truth-table-probe.json`.

The portable task-test stage passed 23/23 with no skips or import diagnostics: `checks/audit/8f10b83435aa-task-tests/result.json`. I also reviewed its five declared semantic rivals and two-example lesson contract. This finite audit does not prove uniqueness against arbitrary non-pointwise or spatial hypotheses, but I found no concrete mislabeled case, surviving plausible shortcut, or advertised-control defect.
